other_conditions: Candidates must have at least 50% marks in diploma or post‑graduate diploma courses in agriculture and allied subjects
Candidates must have at least 55% marks in intermediate (plus‑two) agriculture‑related courses
Degree courses recognized by UGC must have more than 60% of the course content in agriculture and allied subjects
Candidates must provide proof of possession of an Aadhaar number or undergo Aadhaar registration
Eligibility may also depend on approval of the Department of Agriculture & Cooperation on recommendation of the State Government
benefits_summary: Provides full financial support for training, hand‑holding, loans and credit‑linked subsidies to eligible agricultural graduates, diploma holders and related candidates.
documents_required: Copy of request for Aadhaar enrolment
Passbook of Bank or Post Office
Any other document specified by State/UT
